description.html: This 70x45x97 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 305.6 liters comes with a handmade 3D background that gives the interior the look of a natural habitat. The polystyrene background is sculpted as rock, tree bark or cave relief, and every piece is unique because it is made by hand in our workshop.

The vertical format (a height of 97 cm, greater than the 70 cm length) is meant for arboreal species that spend most of their time on branches and leaves. The height leaves room for branches, vines and plants at different levels. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

items: Crested geckos kept as a pair

description.html: You can order this model with a custom film and background. If you need different dimensions or extra equipment (LED lighting, a thermostat, a lock), we build to your specification. Delivery to your address anywhere in Serbia.
